title: Get married at 25
decision: Should a 25-year-old with a partner of 1+ years get married now?

options.label: Engage now, marry in 12 to 18 months

buffett.reason: Who you marry is the biggest long-term value call

bezos.reason: Close to a one-way door; regret frames timing

leila.reason: Marriage is a partnership two people must lead

hormozi.reason: Career momentum at 25, at the edges

brief: A 25-year-old with a stable job, some savings, and a partner of more than a year is leaning toward marrying now. Options are marry now, get engaged and marry in 12 to 18 months after set checks, or wait 2 to 3 years.
assumptions: No detailed money and life-goals talk yet (assumed)
